omu0: AC Joint Injury (Shoulder Tip): Healing Time, Sling and Exercises | İhsan Eren
omu1: Pain and a bump at the tip of the shoulder after a fall onto it: how long an AC joint injury takes to heal, how long to wear a sling, and when to return to work and driving. Six exercises.
omu3: Did you fall onto your shoulder from a bike or during sport, and now have pain, swelling or a bump at the very top of your shoulder? The ligaments of this small joint, where the collarbone meets the shoulder blade, may be sprained or torn. Mild injuries usually heal in 3–6 weeks; most injuries do not need surgery and get better with a sling and exercises.

omu13: Injuries range from a sprain with a normal X-ray to stretched or torn ligaments. In mild injuries, the bones of the joint do not shift at all or only slightly.
omu14: Apply ice wrapped in a towel for 15 minutes every few hours; never put ice directly on your skin.
omu15: Take your painkillers at the dose on the packet; if your pain does not ease, ask your doctor or pharmacist.
omu16: Use the sling to ease the pain. You can take it off for eating, dressing and showering when you feel comfortable; this will not make the injury worse.
omu17: Rest your arm for 24–72 hours, but keep gently moving your fingers, wrist and shoulder.
omu18: Six exercises to keep your shoulder moving
omu19: Start the first four exercises straight away and aim to do them 5 times a day; do fewer if the pain increases. Add the last two from week 3. After week 6 you can start raising your arm forwards and out to the side as high as is comfortable, and return to your daily activities as pain allows.
omu21: Open and close your hand 10 times, then move your wrist up and down 10 times. After a few days, squeeze a soft ball for 5 seconds and let go.
omu23: Bend and straighten your elbow, using your other hand to help if needed. With your elbow bent to 90 degrees at your side, turn your palm up and down. Stop if the pain increases.
omu24: Draw your shoulders back and gently squeeze your shoulder blades together.
omu26: Lean forwards with your good hand resting on a firm surface. Let your injured arm hang loose and gently swing it forwards and backwards, from side to side and in small circles.
omu28: Start from week 3. Lie on your back, hold the wrist of your injured arm with your good hand and lift it up towards your head as far as is comfortable, then lower it.
omu30: Start from week 3. Keep your elbow bent at your side and use a stick or umbrella to push your forearm outwards. If you have no stick, guide your wrist outwards with your good hand.
omu31: Usually not; most shoulder tip injuries heal with a sling, exercises and physiotherapy. Surgery may be considered in some cases where the ligaments are badly torn and the joint is clearly separated. After surgery the sling is usually worn for 6 weeks, and returning to contact sports takes about 12 weeks.
omu32: Will the bump on my shoulder go away?
omu33: After a mild injury, it is normal for a small, painless bump to remain at the end of the collarbone once it has healed; it does not affect your daily activities. Symptoms can last 3–6 months.
omu34: It depends on your job. According to one NHS leaflet, you can return to light work with no lifting after 1–3 weeks, to work involving light lifting below shoulder level after 3–6 weeks, and to heavy work above shoulder level after 6–12 weeks.
omu35: When you have stopped using the sling, can turn the steering wheel without pain and can react to emergencies such as an emergency stop without pain or hesitation. Do not drive while wearing the sling, try it in a safe place first and make sure your insurance covers you.
omu36: Lie on your back or on your good side, not on the injured shoulder. When lying on your back, you can put a pillow under the elbow of your injured arm. When lying on your side, a pillow in front of you helps rest your hand.

omu40: If you still have marked pain and swelling at week 3
omu41: If you have pain away from your shoulder
omu42: If at week 6 you cannot move your shoulder as well as before the injury
omu43: Smoking and vaping slow healing; stopping or cutting down is especially important in the first 2 weeks.
